claim: Even if you select two Availability Zones when configuring your Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, OpenSearch Service automatically distributes dedicated master nodes across three Availability Zones.
question: OpenSearch Service: how are dedicated master nodes placed when a domain uses two AZs?

qualifiers.scope: dedicated master nodes of a multi-AZ domain
qualifiers.condition: If an older-generation instance type is not available in three Availability Zones, and you chose two zones, the master nodes are distributed across two zones.
